description: Starts a NEW listing video. Takes the address (or a name for a listing with no public address) and, when the person has one, their public listing page link (Zillow, Redfin or a brokerage page), whose photos and facts Reel-E imports. An idempotencyKey, reused on retry, returns the same draft every time. Next come add_listing_photos, optionally set_listing_basics, then start_video. Photos come from the person: attached in the chat where the app supports it, imported from the listing link, or added at addPhotosUrl from the result, a Reel-E page where they drop photos from their computer or phone; get_listing_status then shows the count.

country.description: Country, when outside the United States.

street.description: Street number and name, like '12 Oak Lane'.

unit.description: Unit, apartment or suite, when there is one.

baths.description: Number of bathrooms; halves allowed, like 2.5.

description.description: The listing description, in the person's words.

idempotencyKey.description: 8 to 128 letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores or colons. Reuse it on retry.

listingLink.description: An https link to the public listing page to import.

name.description: Only for a listing with no public address.

price.description: List price in dollars, a plain number like 1200000.

name: start_listing
title: Start a new listing
